what: the stock with r3 rounds on its four top edges, shelled 2 mm open at the bottom
method: the vertical edges stay sharp, so each pair of top rounds meets in a mitre at a corner (08/011's identity): outside, (1-pi/4) 3^2 (2 60 + 2 40) removed, less 4 x 3^3 (5/3 - pi/2) counted twice; the cavity is the 56 x 36 x 18 box (open at z = 0) with its top edges rounded 3 - 2 = 1, mitred alike. V = outside - cavity.
